title: Pepper before evening
body: Idris of Pasai has pepper aboard the Swift and means to be gone by evening. A Zhangzhou buyer wants whatever is left before his own ship sails at noon. Idris sets a handful of pepper between you. “If the court is buying, Shahbandar, pay while the other man is still here.”

choices.label: Buy the lot now at the market price
choices.outcome_text: The royal store takes the pepper and Idris is paid at once. The Zhangzhou buyer sails short of the load he came for.

choices.label: Buy a share and leave the rest to the junk
choices.outcome_text: The treasury pays for a share. The buyer takes the balance before noon, and Idris can sail without waiting for another customer.

choices.label: Leave the whole lot to the buyer
choices.outcome_text: The Zhangzhou buyer takes the lot off Idris's hands. The Swift has its coin and time to make the evening tide; the royal store gets no pepper.
